text_block_list.text:
While getting ready to head back, I saw Mejiro Dober
warming up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I left things unfinished, per se...
There are just parts of it I'm not satisfied with...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run a bit more,
so go on ahead, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to worry so much.
I know how to pace myself...
choice_data_list: I'm watching, so give it everything you've got!
I'm watching, so give it everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: I'm watching, so give it everything you've got!
I'm watching, so give it everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...So that's your condition for solo training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...So that's your condition for solo training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's fine with me, but I'm doing things my own way.
I'll just act as if I don't even have a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...You've gotta be tired too, Trainer.
You're really stubborn about that kind of stuff, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...If you're gonna stay anyway, let me know
if you notice anything."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...If you're gonna stay anyway, let me know
if you notice anything."
And so, Mejiro Dober pushed herself to the limit right up until curfew...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even if I tell you I won't do anything reckless,
you probably won't agree, will you...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I'm not convinced, but I get what
you're trying to say, so I'll drop it for now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And also... it's not like I'm dissatisfied
with the routine you put together, Trainer.

Mejiro Dober spent the after-school hours resting,
refreshing both mind and body...!
